create_StockfishEngine: create a StockfishEngine instance with a chess engine limit for classical Stockfish analysis
run_StockfishEngine_analyse: run StockfishEngine analyse on a chess board position to get analysis results
run_StockfishEngine_play: run StockfishEngine play on a chess board to get the best move
create_AllMovesStockfishEngine: create an AllMovesStockfishEngine that evaluates all legal moves individually
run_AllMovesStockfishEngine_analyse: run AllMovesStockfishEngine analyse to score every legal move on a board
